Subject: Merchant onboarding — payment terms question

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the quick setup intro last week. We're trying to finish vendor onboarding from our side and wanted to confirm Redwood's payment window for merchants. Our standard is Net 60, but we can be flexible if needed. For contract purposes, can you confirm whether Redwood will accept Net 60 or whether you require Net 30/45? Also let me know what documents you need to get us into your PO/payment system (W-9, vendor form, bank details).

A couple of specifics from our procurement team:
- Does Redwood issue a PO on first invoice or upon contract signature?
- Is there a preferred invoice remittance email or portal?

I'll attach our onboarding packet if helpful. Looking to have this live by Dec 10th.

Thanks,
Anna Morales

Hi Anna — thanks for the note and the packet. Looping in Karthik from Vendor Ops; he manages the onboarding flow and PO activation. Quick answers up top:

- Redwood typically prefers Net 30 for new partners on hosted services, but we can make exceptions (Net 45 or Net 60) for strategic partners with procurement approval.
- We generally issue the first PO once the contract is countersigned and the vendor is in the system.
- Preferred remittance is invoices@redwood.ai; we accept emailed invoices and have a vendor portal link (I cc Karthik for the portal link).

Karthik — can you add ClearPay to our onboarding queue and share the vendor form + next steps? Anna, if you can send the W-9 and preferred bank details, that speeds things up.

Best,
Evelyn Hart

Subject: ClearPay vendor onboarding & PO workflow

Hi Anna / Evelyn — thanks, adding ClearPay to the vendor onboarding queue. Please find the attachments below and a short checklist so we can activate in the system:

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (fillable), PO-template.docx (Redwood PO template)

Onboarding checklist (target turnaround: 4–7 business days once we have all docs):
1) Completed vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (company info, tax id, bank remittance)
2) Signed W-9 (for US entities) — we need this to create the vendor record
3) Bank details + ACH authorization (if you want ACH) or remittance email
4) Copy of signed statement of work (if applicable) so we can issue PO against the SOW line items

Regarding payment terms — our default is Net 30. For Net 45 or Net 60 we require Finance approval; that typically takes 1 business day after we submit the vendor packet. An alternative is our early-pay program: Finance can offer a small discount if ClearPay opts into accelerated settlement (example: 1.5% if paid within 15 days). Marcus from Finance is cc'd for confirmation on that.

Doc links:
- Vendor onboarding form (attached)
- Redwood vendor portal: https://vendor.redwood.ai/onboard (internal)

If you want to propose Net 60, please indicate that and upload the completed vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx + W-9. We'll run it through Finance and confirm the final terms.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Hi all — quick note from Finance on payment terms and the early-pay option.

Options we can support for ClearPay:
- Standard: Net 30 (default)
- Extended: Net 45 (approved for established partners)
- Extended: Net 60 (possible but requires VP sign-off and a brief credit/references check)

Early-pay program (optional):
- If ClearPay wants faster settlement, we can offer 1.5% discount on invoice amount for payment within 15 calendar days.
- Enrollment: vendor signs the early-pay addendum during onboarding; Finance enables accelerated settlement on the first PO.

For process items we need from ClearPay to finalize vendor record and issue the first PO:
- Completed vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (attached by Karthik)
- Signed W-9 (please send PDF)
- Remittance instructions (ACH or wire preferred)

If Anna confirms Net 60 is required, we'll route to VP of Finance for sign-off (timeline: 24–48 business hours). If you'd like to proceed faster, propose Net 45 and enroll in early-pay if you want a quicker cash cycle (we'll still issue PO upon contract signature).

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
